annotations.title: Create a Meta ad account in a business portfolio

description: Create a new Meta ad account inside one of this login's business portfolios: businessId, name, currency (ISO, permanent), timezoneId (Meta's numeric id, 1 = America/Los_Angeles; permanent). Optional endAdvertiser / mediaAgency / partner (a Page or app id, default NONE), fundingId, invoice, invoiceGroupId, invoicingEmails, io, poNumber. Meta ad accounts cannot be deleted, only closed, and Meta caps how many a business may create. Needs confirm:true after the user agrees. The account starts with no payment method; to build on it here, add it with set_connector_accounts. Free.

endAdvertiser.description: Page or app id the ads are for, or NONE

invoice.description: attach to the business credit line

mediaAgency.description: agency Page or app id, or NONE

partner.description: partner Page or app id, or NONE

timezoneId.description: Meta's numeric time zone id; permanent
